answer: A hostile operator running 134 aliases thus needs 81 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in kernel, expire in meadow, and knoll lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4932 identities would post 1546 proofs and burn roughly 83 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
